note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. LGA-14L numbering from DocID030071 Rev 3 Table 2 (p.20) and Figure 1 (p.18). The KiCad symbol Sensor_Motion:LSM6DS3 has the same 14 numbers and functions (checked pin by pin in KiCad 9 and 10); its names differ only in case (SDX, SCX for SDx, SCx).

I2C_SDA.note: I2C serial data (SDA); SPI SDI / 3-wire SDO when CS is low. Input without pull-up (Table 18 p.48): needs an external pull-up to Vdd_IO (§6.3 p.39). Standard or fast mode, 400 kHz max (Table 7 p.27)

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

I2C_SCL.note: I2C serial clock (SCL); SPI SPC when CS is low. Input without pull-up (Table 18 p.48); needs an external pull-up to Vdd_IO

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

SA0.note: I2C address LSb (SA0) in I2C mode, SPI SDO otherwise. Input without pull-up by default (pull-up only with SIM = 1, Table 18 p.47): tie to GND (address 0x6A, 1101010b) or to the supply (0x6B, 1101011b), §6.3.1 p.39

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

CS.note: 1: SPI idle / I2C enabled; 0: SPI, I2C disabled. Tie to Vdd_IO for I2C (§6.1 p.38). Input with pull-up by default (disabled by I2C_disable = 1, Table 18 p.47), but the datasheet still asks for it tied high

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

INT.note: Programmable interrupt outputs, push-pull and active high by default (CTRL3_C PP_OD = 0, H_LACTIVE = 0, §9.15 p.63); open drain or active low by register. Default pin state: output forced to ground (Table 18 p.47). Unlike the LSM6DSO there is no I3C and no power-on strap on INT1. INT2 is also the DEN input (Table 2 p.20)

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

AUX_MASTER.note: SDx/SCx: I2C master (MSDA/MSCL) in Mode 2. In Mode 1 (unused): connect to VDDIO or GND (Table 2 p.20). Input without pull-up by default (PULL_UP_EN in 1Ah enables one, Table 18 p.47), so the pin must be tied

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

NC.note: Pins 10, 11: 'Leave unconnected', electrically unconnected but soldered to the PCB (Table 2 note 2, p.20). Input with internal 30-50 kohm pull-up by default, which a register sequence can disable (Table 18 pp.47-48). (The LSM6DSM/LSM6DSO have OCS_Aux/SDO_Aux here; this part does not)

VDD.note: Core supply, 1.71-3.6 V (1.8 V typ); absolute max -0.3 to 4.8 V. 100 nF ceramic as near the pin as possible (C1 in Figure 15)

VDDIO.note: I/O supply, 1.62 V to Vdd + 0.1 V (so at most 3.6 + 0.1, and never more than 0.1 V above VDD); sets the logic levels (VIH 0.7*Vdd_IO, VIL 0.3*Vdd_IO) and the pull-up rail. 100 nF ceramic as near the pin as possible (C2 in Figure 15). nominal_v's 3.6 is VDD's maximum, the bound when VDDIO shares VDD's rail

GND.note: 0 V supply, pins 6 and 7; both are soldered

i2c.note: No internal pull-ups on SDA and SCL: the bus needs them, to Vdd_IO. Slave address 110101xb, x = SA0

spi.note: 4-wire SPI (10 MHz max, Table 6 p.26) when CS is low: SPC on SCL, SDI on SDA, SDO on SDO/SA0. Not available in this package's circuit, which ties CS to VDDIO for I2C

citation.locator: §3.1 Table 2 p.20; §6.1 Table 10 p.38; Table 6 p.26

int1.note: Push-pull and active high by default (open drain or active low by CTRL3_C). Forced to ground by default

int2.note: Push-pull and active high by default; forced to ground by default. Also the DEN input. May be left unconnected

aux.note: Sensor hub (Mode 2): an I2C master for external sensors, fast mode only. Unused (Mode 1): SDx and SCx to VDDIO or GND
